name: Super Stellar Demo
summary: Cosmic Shooter VR is an intense and immersive virtual reality game that thrusts players into the heart of a galactic battle. Armed with dual guns, you embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through space, obliterating objects and enemies that stand in your way. With stunning visuals, responsive controls, and captivating gameplay, Cosmic Shooter VR delivers an unforgettable VR shooting experience that transports you to the far reaches of the cosmos.
